When a runaway reindeer threatens their annual Christmas play, a dysfunctional couple must work together to save the holidays for the town and each other.
A loving couple shares the story of how they met and fell in love when their daughter's boyfriend comes to meet them for the first time at Christmas.
In order to keep Elizabeth employed at her real estate business, her soon-to-be father-in-law sends her back to her hometown to persuade an ex-boyfriend to sell his ski resort.
Three generations on Cherry Lane experience life-changing Christmases, from a mistaken address leading to a live TV special, to a family facing their last holiday together.
Three reluctant siblings join their parents on a Christmas cruise through Europe. They find unexpected joy and romance along the way, while dealing with personal issues.
Despite their schedules causing distance, Olivia and Prince Alexander travel to Torovia for Christmas with his family, where clashing cultures between their families lead to chaos.
Across three different eras, different families occupy a family home, leaving their own festive mark throughout the years despite life's challenges.
When Beatrice reluctantly joins her best friend on a trip to the enchanting Christmasland, she remains sceptical. But festive traditions and a friendly stranger warms her heart.
Princess Victoria is ready for a change of pace. Looking to decompress, she decides to take a vacation to Peaceful Pines Ranch in Montana.
A book editor takes on a temporary gig running a bookstore, where her battles with the owner's son allow her to rediscover her passion for nurturing creativity.
Celeste and Jason get engaged and ask her pastor father - who's not ready to let his daughter go - to officiate their Christmas wedding.
Wellness expert Juliet enlists candle store owner Tom's help making Christmas memory candles. Will their differing views lead to success or disaster.
Former rivals Blair and Josh must work Christmas duty together. When a snowstorm threatens holiday deliveries to the base, they're forced to cooperate to save Christmas.
Christmas-hating chef Carol only agrees to go to her boyfriend's home for the holidays so she can find out his mum's biscuit recipe, but then the festive magic starts to get to her.
Feeling the pressure to bring someone home for Christmas, Jessie convinces Bryan to join her family, only the family doesn't know it's their first date.
The Brenner brothers are back and putting on a holiday pageant for young Thomas, while trying to cope with life's curveballs, including their mum's new boyfriend.
